sn2.21:1.3: This is the only appearance of Shiva (_siva_, “auspicious”, “kindly”) in early Pali. In the Rig Veda he appears a few times under the name Rudra, the “roarer”, where he is feared but approached as dispenser of blessed healing (Rig Veda 2.33). As time went on his kindly aspect became more prominet, but he never lost his destructive side. He was not normally known as Shiva until the Purāṇic period.
